PDF Fundamental Idea of Splatting - Stony Brook University
• Most of the splatting algorithm pipeline can be implemented on commodity 3D graphics hardware using texture-mapping and geometric transformations to compute the 3D→2D kernel projection • As with ray-casting, in splatting we need only to process "interesting" voxels and ignore the rest
